principle: The normalization target for EVERY ingested source (owner-specified 2026-06-25). Every object — code, tool, prompt, API, record, search result, completion, failure — is decomposed into this one schema, then interrogated, standardized, and stored in a registry. 'Ingest seed intelligence → normalize to this schema → interrogate → generate open standardized components → registry → recurse.' serves_truth=false (every ingested object is a CANDIDATE; verify before promotion — discovery ≠ trust). PUBLIC metadata only; no PII/secrets.

fields.object_id: stable content-hash id (never truncation-only; see CLAUDE.md ID/Hash discipline)
fields.source: where it came from (seed_sources.jsonl id + url + retrieval rung)
fields.capabilities: what it can do (verbs/skills it exposes)
fields.failure_modes: known ways it breaks (feeds the Doctor/Recovery layer)
fields.fallbacks: what to try when it fails (feeds Open Recovery Format)
fields.alternatives: substitutable objects that do the same job
fields.cost_profile: cost tier / per-call cost (feeds the descent)
fields.auth_requirements: key/credential needed (env var ref into credential_registry)
fields.retry_strategies: how to retry (feeds Open Kickstart Format)
fields.open_questions: what we still need to answer (spawns subtasks)
fields.adjacent_tools: neighboring capabilities to also ingest (recursive expansion)
fields.integration_points: where it connects in a pipeline
fields.improvement_candidates: cheaper/bounded/deterministic/stateless variants to build (the two-axis admission target)
fields.confidence_score: 0..1 confidence the record is correct (gates promotion)
fields.permissions_required: scopes/permissions the object needs to run
fields.sandbox_requirements: isolation needed (none|non-main|all; Docker/SSH) — OpenClaw pattern, but OURS is stricter (untrusted third-party skills)
fields.determinism_score: 0..1 — 1=pure deterministic tool, 0=free-form LLM. THE descent target (raise it; remove the model from the path)
fields.security_risk: risk tier + notes (third-party skills are untrusted by default)
fields.competing_implementations: alternates that do the same job (for arbitrage + replacement)
fields.replacement_candidates: cheaper/bounded/deterministic objects that could replace this

recursive_questioning_meta_rule.trigger: Every ingested object IMMEDIATELY triggers this interrogation (the Open Interrogation Format core).
questions: What capabilities exist? What capabilities are missing?
Can it be decomposed? modularized? composable? portable? stateless? replaceable?
Can it become DETERMINISTIC? cheaper? bounded? (the Teleon descent target)
What lighter implementations / variants should exist?
Can it be standardized / protocolized / made an open format?
Who else exposes this (competitors/forks/adjacent)? — spawn ingest tasks for each
recursive_questioning_meta_rule.spawns: Each unresolved question + each adjacent_tool + each missing_metadata field becomes a new task in data/dev-intel/ (the recursive knowledge-expansion engine).
